description: This Java class defines an integration test suite for share account functionalities in the Apache Fineract platform. It contains tests for creating, updating, approving, rejecting, applying additional shares, activating, redeeming, and closing share accounts, including handling charges and transactions.

classes.name: ShareAccountIntegrationTests
classes.description: Contains multiple test methods to verify the functionality of share accounts including creation, approval, rejection, activation, redemption, and closing, along with handling charges and additional share applications.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the RESTAssured configuration, request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: testCreateShareProduct
methods.description: Tests creation, retrieval, and update of a share product.

methods.name: testCreateShareAccount
methods.description: Tests the end-to-end flow for creating a share account and verifying transactions.

methods.name: testShareAccountApproval
methods.description: Tests approving a share account, verifying state and transactions.

methods.name: rejectShareAccount
methods.description: Tests rejection of a share account and verifies state and transactions.

methods.name: testShareAccountUndoApproval
methods.description: Tests undoing the approval of a share account, verifying that it reverts to submitted state.

methods.name: testCreateShareAccountWithCharges
methods.description: Tests creation of a share account with associated charges and verifies charges management through later commands and state transitions.

methods.name: testCreateShareAccountWithCharges (with additional complexity)
methods.description: A comprehensive test that creates, activates, approves, applies additional shares, rejects, redeems, and closes a share account, verifying charges, states, and transactions at each step.
